title: FujiMod OTA release manifest
description: latest.json names one firmware release. Each fs key is an absolute path in the camera file layer; its value is the complete SHA-256 and byte size of the store file for that path. The camera applies a release when its version differs from the active system manifest, in either direction.

firmware.description: Firmware id of the release, such as X70-110. It must equal the running camera's firmware directory name.

version.description: Release version compared with the active system manifest. Any difference, including an older version, is an update.

date.description: UTC calendar date of the Git commit used to build this release.

commit.description: Git commit used to build this release.

notes.description: Short release-note bullets. Each string is limited to 64 UTF-8 bytes.

fs.description: Published file layer paths mapped to their content-addressed store files.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of the store file, in hexadecimal.
